items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Legen Sie nicht binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung Einspruch ein, wird dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig, und die Geldbuße kann vollstreckt werden.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde copy shows the notice was formally served (zugestellt) on 04.11.2026 (Wednesday) — formal service under § 182 ZPO, so there is no statutory 'deemed delivery' fiction; the stated delivery day itself is the start of the period. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (04.11.) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) therefore runs from 05.11.2026 and would end Wednesday 18.11.2026. 18.11.2026 is Buß- und Bettag, a public holiday in Sachsen, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline shifts to the next working day, Thursday 19.11.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Gesamtbetrag) once the notice is final
items.quote: Den Gesamtbetrag zahlen Sie bitte, sobald dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig ist – spätestens zwei Wochen danach – unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das Konto DE77 8505 0300 0005 1500 00.
items.computation: The notice becomes rechtskräftig (final) when the Einspruch period expires unused, i.e. at the end of 19.11.2026 (see the objection deadline above). The letter allows payment 'spätestens zwei Wochen danach' (at the latest two weeks after that). Counting from 19.11.2026 (not counted, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) end Thursday 03.12.2026, which is a normal working day in Sachsen, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The scanned Zustellungsurkunde shows the delivery date as the truncated '04.11.20' with the year cut off; I assumed 2026 (six days after the notice's own date of 30.10.2026), but the person should check the original slip to confirm the full date, since both the Einspruch deadline and the payment deadline depend directly on it.

The payment due date is only an estimate: it depends on the exact day the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (unappealed), which in turn depends on confirming the true delivery date above; if no Einspruch is filed, the authority itself will usually confirm the Rechtskraft date.

The IBAN DE77 8505 0300 0005 1500 00 is a valid, well-formed German IBAN at Bankleitzahl 85050300, consistent with a German authority account, but as with any payment the payee name shown by your bank during the transfer should match 'Landkreis Beispielelbe' or 'Ostsächsische Musterkasse' before sending money.
